geometry.doc: Where things are: cells, ground heights, reachability, path ranks and the points citizens work from.

orders.doc: Giving citizens their orders: workers of a building, queued actions and the think hook.

building.doc: Construction work: carrying materials to a site and building it (GatherRawMaterials, Build).

sites.doc: Building sites and buildings: becoming a site or a building, marking them on the map, and destroying them.

callbacks.doc: The building state callbacks ([`Callbacks`]) that construction and destruction call.

work_host.doc: The job manager's work slots ([`WorkHost`]): offering, assigning, finishing and cancelling work.

clearing.doc: Clearing an area (`ClearArea`): removing trees, rocks and other resources before building.

piles.doc: Loose piles of goods on the ground (`RawMaterialComponent`): making, joining, taking and ageing them.

storage.doc: Taking goods to storage: picking up piles, finding a storage, dropping off, and emptying a storage (Pickup, ClearStorage).
